component.name: SpacePenguin
component.summary: Browse the web without ads or trackers

description.p: SpacePenguin is a small, fast web browser built on Qt and Chromium's engine. It blocks ads and trackers, YouTube's ads too, and never phones home.

ul.li: Ad and tracker blocking with EasyList, EasyPrivacy and other filter lists
YouTube ads removed, and sponsor segments skipped with SponsorBlock
Private windows that keep nothing on disk, and Tor windows
Saved logins kept in your desktop's keyring
Tabs on top or on the side, tab groups, reader view and session restore
User scripts, and sites installed as apps
Tools for developers, gamers, students, workers and teachers

screenshot.caption: The start page, with tabs and the address bar

description.p: The first release: saved logins in the keyring, crash recovery, and a Flatpak.
